# Vibranium Mod

[![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.1-brightgreen.svg)](https://minecraft.net/)
[![Mod Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modloader-Fabric%20%7C%20NeoForge-blue.svg)](https://architectury.dev/)
[![Architectury API](https://img.shields.io/badge/API-Architectury-orange.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)

A multi-loader Minecraft mod built with **Architectury API** that brings the mythical element of **Vibranium** into your world. Discover rare meteorite structures, smelt advanced materials, and harness the power of the Black Panther!

---

## 🛠 Features

- **Natural World Generation**: Find Vibranium meteorites buried deep in the Overworld and End.
- **Industrial Processing & Energy**: Refine raw materials into high-purity ingots, build advanced furnaces, and construct a reactor for energy distribution.
- **Advanced Tools & Armour**: Craft durable Vibranium gear that absorbs and redistributes kinetic energy.
  
---

## 📦 Requirements & Dependencies

To run **Vibranium**, ensure you have installed the correct mod loader and required dependency mods:

### Fabric Edition
* **Minecraft**: `1.21.1`
* **Fabric Loader**: `>=0.16.0`
* **Fabric API**: Required
* **Architectury API (Fabric)**: `19.0.1`
* **Cloth Config (Fabric)**: `21.11.151`

### NeoForge Edition
* **Minecraft**: `1.21.1`
* **NeoForge**: `>=21.1.0`
* **Architectury API (NeoForge)**: `19.0.1`
* **Cloth Config (NeoForge)**: `21.11.151`


---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest version of the mod for your loader (Fabric or NeoForge) from the Releases tab or Modrinth/CurseForge.
2. Install the appropriate mod loader for Minecraft `1.21.1`.
3. Place the downloaded `.jar` file along with **Architectury API** and **Cloth Config** (and **Fabric API** if using Fabric) into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and explore!

   
---

If you use the Nature X resource pack, here is a resource pack to align Vibranium Mod textures with it: [Vibranium-x-Nature-X](https://github.com/Leiriad/Vibranium-x-Nature-X/releases/tag/v1.21.11-1.0.0)

## 🤖 AI Usage Statement

AI tools were used strictly as a coding assistant for brainstorming and accelerating logic writing. 

All assets, including custom textures, models, sound design, and game balance, were created entirely by hand. No AI generation was used for visual or audio content.
